verdict.rationale: Thoropass's own MCP documentation says the assistant works inside the workspace "within limits you set," and that users can add or remove items "depending on what you want your agent to be able to do." That points to configurable, least-privilege permissions for an agent connection, but the evidence never describes issuing a dedicated API credential or what the scopes are. missing for 10: explicit documentation of issuing agent-specific API credentials or tokens, a defined list of permission scopes, credential rotation and revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: MCP lets the assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace, within limits you set.
Add or remove the last three depending on what you want your agent to be able to do.
